how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates can apply only through the online mode on the official BEML career page. Follow these steps:
Visit the official BEML website: www.bemlindia.in.
Go to the Careers section and locate the notification for Draft Advt No. KP/S/14/2026.
Read the detailed advertisement carefully before proceeding.
Register using a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and ensure both remain active for at least one year.
Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and category details.
Upload all required documents as per the checklist mentioned in the notification.
Pay the applicable non-refundable application fee (if applicable to your category).
Submit the form and note down the Registration Number generated for future correspondence.
The online registration will remain open till 18:00 Hrs on 8th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they apply well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues.
important_instructions: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. SC/ST candidates must submit a Caste Certificate in the Government of India format. OBC candidates must submit a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate not older than six months as on the last date of application, along with a self-undertaking. PwD candidates must submit a PwD Certificate in the prescribed format. EWS candidates must submit an Income & Assets Certificate in the applicable format. Any request for change in category, address, e-mail, mobile number, or test centre location, once declared in the online application, will not be entertained. Merely meeting the eligibility conditions does not automatically entitle a candidate to appointment. BEML reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates, change the qualifying percentage, increase/decrease vacancies, or cancel the recruitment process at its discretion. Selected candidates will be engaged for a maximum tenure of four years, terminable by either party with one month's notice or pay in lieu of notice. Candidates are advised to beware of fraudulent agencies; the recruitment process is handled solely by BEML's Recruitment Cell. For queries, candidates may e-mail [email protected]. Any Corrigendum/Addendum will be published on the official BEML website.

Candidates who have completed their diploma or graduate-level qualification in engineering can also explore more Diploma Government Jobs and Engineering Government Jobs available across India. content_sections.text: The notification does not mention the exact start date for online registration. Candidates should keep checking the official BEML career page for this update.

content_sections.heading: BEML Non Executive Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: BEML has notified a total of 10 vacancies for the post of Non Executive (Tenure Basis), with the following category-wise breakup: SC-1, ST-0, OBC-2, EWS-1, and UR-6.

content_sections.heading: BEML Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification and age limit criteria mentioned below as on 8th September 2026. 3-year full-time Polytechnic Engineering Diploma in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Instrumentation, Industrial Electronics, or Mechatronics. The diploma must be a regular course from an AICTE/DCTE-approved College/Institution. Candidates must have secured a First Class with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks. A relaxation of 5% in the minimum qualifying marks is available for SC/ST/PwD candidates.

content_sections.heading: BEML Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit shown above already factors in the following relaxations as per Government of India norms: SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation OBC candidates: 3 years relaxation PwD candidates: an additional 10 years over and above the relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), applicable to candidates with a minimum of 40% disability Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: BEML Recruitment 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged on tenure basis and paid the following monthly consolidated remuneration: An annual increase of 3% on the Basic Pay is admissible during the tenure, subject to satisfactory performance. Provident Fund is calculated on Basic Pay + DA. Candidates will also be eligible for Gratuity (as per the Gratuity Scheme) and Bonus (as per the Bonus Act), and are covered under applicable Income Tax, Service Tax, and Professional Tax rules.

content_sections.heading: BEML Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Non Executive (Tenure Basis) post will be based on the following process: The Computer Based Test will be of 2 hours duration, with 1 mark for each correct answer and no negative marking. The qualifying marks for the written test are fixed at 60%, relaxable by 5% for SC/ST/PwD candidates. Final selection is based purely on merit (marks scored) in the written test. Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification, limited to the number of notified vacancies (discipline/category-wise). Candidates qualifying in Document Verification must undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination. A Provisional Offer is issued after Document Verification, followed by a Final Offer of Engagement after a satisfactory Medical Report. Candidates qualifying for Document Verification will be reimbursed Travelling Allowance (Sleeper Class/II Class train fare or bus fare by the shortest route), subject to production of proof of journey.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BEML Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online registration for BEML Non-Executive (Tenure Basis) Recruitment 2026 closes at 18:00 Hrs on 8th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEML has notified 10 vacancies for the post of Non-Executive on Tenure Basis under Draft Advt No. KP/S/14/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for BEML Non-Executive posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 3-year full-time Polytechnic Diploma in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Instrumentation, Industrial Electronics, or Mechatronics, with a minimum of 60% marks (First Class), from an AICTE/DCTE-approved institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 29 years for GEN/EWS, 32 years for OBC, and 34 years for SC/ST candidates, as on 8th September 2026, with additional relaxation for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for BEML Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- (non-refundable) for GEN/EWS/OBC candidates. SC, ST, and PwD candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for BEML Non-Executive (Tenure Basis) post?
faq.answer: The Basic Pay is Rs. 23,910/- per month, along with Dearness Allowance (currently 55.7%), HRA (where applicable), medical allowance of Rs. 1,500/- per month, and other perks as applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Computer Based Written Test (General Awareness, English & Reasoning, and Concerned Discipline), followed by Document Verification and a Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the BEML written test?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking. Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
